description: Live shipping prices for a parcel sent WITHIN Australia, from two independent sources at once: Australia Post retail (PAC) and Easyship's pre-negotiated commercial courier panel. Returns every service with price, currency and transit time where available, cheapest first, plus a note on why the two sources are not directly comparable. Use when asked what it costs to send a parcel between Australian postcodes, or which courier is cheapest for a given weight and route.

category.description: Optional goods category, needed by Easyship. One of: accessory_no_battery, accessory_with_battery, audio_video, bags_luggages, books_collectibles, cameras, computers_laptops, documents, dry_food_supplements, fashion, health_beauty, home_appliances, home_decor, jewelry, mobile_phones, pet_accessory, sport_leisure, tablets, toys, watches. Defaults to 'fashion'. Call list_goods_categories if unsure.

value_aud.description: Optional declared value in AUD. Defaults to 100. Does not affect domestic price, only insurance options.

weight_kg.description: Parcel weight in kilograms. AusPost caps domestic parcels at 22kg.
